viewing_check: Estimate 20-40 for the whole box, no bid yet. Dungeon! (1981) is the value: complete copies sold A$58-144 over 2024-2026 (about 7 sales), incomplete ones A$36-73. Check at viewing that the box holds the board, 4 hero/monster card decks, dice, tokens and rules. Prices flat to slightly rising. Other games (Boggle, Scattergories, Junior Scrabble, Monopoly Junior, Word Yahtzee) are low value; hex tiles and dominoes loose. Many Terapeak US entries are AUD conversions of USD listings, so Australian buyers typically pay near the lower figures.
